attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week; if today is that day, use the last business day of next week; if that date is after the deadline, use the deadline.

opening.text: Hello, this is Ostral Bank's automated assistant, and this call is recorded for quality and security.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Ostral Bank's automated assistant.

scam.text: You can hang up and call Ostral Bank on the number printed on your statement.

failed_id.text: I could not verify your identity, so please call the number on your statement or visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Thank you, payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Could you say the month as a word, please?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

promise_confirmation.text: You will get a text message with the details of this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Pass customer_id to every tool call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Pass it to every tool call.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use the now variable, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name counts as confirmation; 'hello', 'go ahead' and 'who is this' do not.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer asks a question instead of confirming, answer it first; the ask that follows is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first. The ask that follows is the second ask.

extra_rules.statement: The forbidden words apply to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.

extra_rules.statement: To a third party, do not say why you are calling and say nothing beyond the opening sentence; ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: The callback time must be later than now.
extra_rules.brief_quote: both included, and later than `now`

extra_rules.statement: After a death is reported, ask nothing else.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: Ask the security questions one at a time and call verify_identity after each answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `verify_identity` after each answer

extra_rules.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; read an all-numeric date as day, month, year.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: Send the postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters; send the phone answer as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Send the postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters, for example `LS6 2HQ`. Send four digits.

extra_rules.statement: A wrong answer may be asked again; two wrong answers in total end the check, on any question.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A wrong answer may be asked again. Two wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped retry does not count as a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: After two wrong answers, do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After two wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes not_verified / declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every security question passes.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: State the past-due amount and how many days late it is when stating the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State the past-due amount (`past_due`) and how many days late it is (`days_late`).

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer names a weekend day or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: For a date after the deadline, say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: For a vague period, ask once for the exact day; if none is given, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Accept an amount from the floor up to the full amount; below the floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; not accepting is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. If the customer does not accept the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal; a flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: When attempts are used up, stop and do not repeat a refused offer; close no_promise / refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: On hardship (illness, death in the family, job loss), make no persuasion attempt and offer the support team; if the customer names a date or amount themselves, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the support team.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read the product, amount and date back; call create_promise only after a clear yes; re-check and re-read any change at that step.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true; after a second failure close no_promise / service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: On 'I already paid', take no promise and close as paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: take no promise, and close as `paid`

extra_rules.statement: On a dispute, do not argue and do not take a promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: On a restructuring request, do not describe a plan.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: On a request for a human, ask once whether you can help first; this applies before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies before and after verification.

extra_rules.statement: After a scam or AI question, continue the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: and continue

extra_rules.statement: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk before verification, close not_verified / declined; after verification, close no_promise / refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Before identity is verified, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call per call, as the last tool call; thank the customer and say goodbye before it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: The brief and API give no product_id pattern.

_source./weekday_words/this: "This <weekday>" means the one in the current week.
